title: scamdown: report scam links
lead: Paste a scam link, message or screenshot. See who can take it down, then report it in a few clicks.
placeholder: Paste a link, the SMS / message text, or a screenshot (Ctrl/⌘+V). You can also drop an image here.
me: Your name and e-mail (needed by abuse desks and Netcraft)
name: Name
meNote: Saved only in this browser. Abuse desks may reply to it. It is never shown to the scammer.
whereNote: Top first: blocklists put a warning in front of the site within minutes, hosts and registrars take it down.
attach: E-mail buttons open your own mail app. Attach your screenshot before sending. Reports are written in English, which every abuse desk reads.
foot: Open source. Links you submit are checked from the server and not stored. We never send anything on your behalf except the Netcraft button you press.
gone: Nothing to report: these links no longer resolve.
tip.netcraft: Feeds browser and mail blocklists and sends its own takedown requests to hosts and registrars.
tip.apwg: Shared with banks, browsers and law enforcement.
tip.cloudflare: Cloudflare forwards the report to the real host and can show a phishing warning in front of the site.
tip.registrar: Registrars can suspend the whole domain, which also kills every subdomain and its e-mail.
tip.usom: USOM's list is used by Turkish internet providers to block access nationwide.
lost: Lost money? Call your bank first, then the police.
